tools.name: mirror_compile
tools.description: focus: tokenize one .mirror file through grammar lens. Returns SHA-256 hash on success.

tools.name: mirror_craft
tools.description: split: converge a target to lambda_0. --target emits code (binary|rust|gleam). --reflect verifies properties without emission.

emit_target.description: Optional --target value: binary, rust, or gleam

reflect.description: If true, pass --reflect (verify only, no emission)

tools.name: mirror_kintsugi
tools.description: refract: settle a .mirror file, write canonical. --liquid writes inferred properties below ---. --shatter N recursively settles N levels deep. Mutates the file. For read-only verdict inspection use mirror_verdict.

liquid.description: If true, pass --liquid (project inferred properties below ---)

shatter.description: If set, pass --shatter N (recursive settle N levels)

tools.name: mirror_verdict
tools.description: focus: render a structured PASS/REJECT verdict envelope for a .mirror file or directory (corpus mode). Read-only — does NOT modify the file. Returns the substrate's JSON verdict envelope (fields: verdict, target, objective, iterations, dark_count). isError lifts to true when verdict.label ∈ {partial, failure}; success returns isError absent.

file.description: Path to .mirror file or directory (corpus mode)

shatter.description: If set, pass --shatter N (recursive verdict N levels)
